rules.alternatives: No separate APRN contact-hour rule at renewal: the APRN must hold national certification for each role/population focus, and to renew prescriptive authority a current national certification showing the CE mandated by the certifying body.

topics.who: APRNs with a DEA registration and controlled substance prescriptive authority (pain management and opioid use and addiction)

rules.notes: Biennial APRN renewal. RN license CE (12 AAC 44.600-.660) still applies to the underlying RN license. 12 AAC 44.400(a)(4) also mentions 60 contact hours every two years when the certifying body has no CE requirement.
